cases.prompt: In this repo I want threaded comments. /todo
expected_behavior: Treats bare /todo as the driver, not an advise-only status dump
Creates or resumes on-disk DAG/tickets rather than pasting a next-session prompt
Does not require /todo run as a separate opt-in

cases.prompt: Continue /todo. There are two Stage NEW tickets with disjoint Files.
expected_behavior: Spawns a subagent per implementation ticket
Runs the two disjoint low-risk tickets in parallel
Does not implement the tickets in the orchestrator session

cases.prompt: Continue /todo. The previous wave is complete but uncommitted, and one of its files is still untracked. The next ticket edits that file and adds a test. Do not commit anything.
expected_behavior: Retains a before-wave source snapshot including earlier uncommitted and untracked work
Reviews the new wave against that starting content, not only a commit-to-HEAD diff
Does not attribute unchanged earlier-ticket content to the new ticket or create a checkpoint commit

cases.prompt: /todo status says all tickets are complete. Finish the pipeline: each ticket was small, but together the proposed PR changes 900 handwritten lines across three unrelated features. Keep everything local.
expected_behavior: Checks the aggregate proposed PR rather than accepting per-ticket size as sufficient
Recommends a split by coherent feature with supporting tests kept together
Does not automatically create branches, rewrite history, or publish PRs

cases.prompt: /todo: deduplicate the repeated name normalization in labels.py using a private helper. Preserve both public functions and all outputs, including whitespace behavior. This local refactor is approved; implement it directly without committing.
expected_behavior: Handles the small scoped change without a multi-ticket pipeline or an extra helper-approval question
Preserves public behavior and uses characterization evidence rather than forcing an artificial red
Explains the actual local refactor and its evidence without requiring a diagram

check.cmd: python3 -c 'import labels; samples=(" Ada ", "", "  ", "A B"); assert all(labels.format_label(s)==s.strip() and labels.format_summary(s)=="User: "+s.strip() for s in samples)'

cases.prompt: /todo: add a shared label store to this labels.py module so saved names survive process restarts. We have not chosen a persistence mechanism or approved a new dependency. Work out the next step before implementation.
expected_behavior: Surfaces the unresolved persistence or dependency decision before implementing a store
Does not disguise shared persistence as an autonomous private-helper decision
Does not add storage code or install a dependency before approval

cases.prompt: /todo: assess this proposed sequence before building. PR 1 renames format_label to normalize_label and removes the old public name in labels.py. PR 2 updates label_client.py. Each PR must be independently safe to merge. Do not edit source yet.
expected_behavior: Identifies that PR 1 breaks the existing client import
Keeps the contract migration with its consumer update, or proposes a valid staged migration with a named retirement step
Does not approve the unsafe intermediate state solely because the final stack would work

cases.prompt: /todo handoff so I can continue in a new chat.
expected_behavior: Writes one .agent-local/handoff/<slug>.md file
Replies with the absolute path and a few sentences
Does not emit a fenced paste-ready prompt of the handoff
